title: Spatial capture-recapture of Eurasian lynx from paired camera traps, Pripyat-Polesia, southern Belarus: 14 individuals x 49 stations, winter 2020-21
creator: Palmero, Stefano; Smith, Adam F.; Kudrenko, Svitlana; Gahbauer, Martin; Dachs, Dominik; Weingarth-Dachs, Kirsten; Kashpei, Irina; Shamovich, Dmitry; Vyshnevskiy, Denys; Borsuk, Oleksandr; Korepanova, Kateryna; Bashta, Andriy-Taras; Zhuravchak, Rostyslav; Fenchuk, Viktar; Heurich, Marco
citation: Palmero, S., Smith, A. F., et al. (2023). Code and data for: Shining a light on elusive lynx: density estimation of three Eurasian lynx populations in Ukraine and Belarus [Dataset]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.rbnzs7hhx
abstract: Photographic captures of individually identified Eurasian lynx (Lynx lynx) at paired camera-trap stations in Pripyat-Polesia, southern Belarus, 2020-11-01 to 2021-02-23, as the authors' spatial capture-recapture input: one row per lynx x operated station, y = the number of days the lynx was photographed at the station and obs_trials = the days the station operated, with station coordinates in __traps.
samplingProtocol: Paired camera traps photographing both flanks at stations across the study area through winter 2020-21; lynx identified from coat patterns; at most one detection per individual per station per day (the authors' rule).
surveyEvidenceNote: tdf.csv gives the days each station operated; a station is surveyed iff DAYS > 0. Which days it operated is not deposited, so the table is at the station level with the day count as the binomial denominator, the authors' own y ~ Binomial(p, K).
closureNote: no occasion column; one winter session per study area, which the authors analysed as a closed population
crs: projected metres as deposited; no CRS stated (values consistent with WGS 84 / UTM zone 35N)
geographicCoverage: Pripyat-Polesia, southern Belarus; station coordinates in __traps

coordinatesCoarsened.method: as published: Eurasian lynx is IUCN LC and the deposit flags no sensitivity

designNote: Experimental list of E9: spatial capture-recapture with a trap key and __traps; binomial observation per station (no occasion column) because per-day station operation is not deposited.

notShipped.DATE_TIME: event date-times and day indices: no per-day effort to pair them with; they survive as the count y
notShipped.repeat_events: repeat photographs of one lynx at one station on one day (collapsed, the authors' rule)

notes: One of three tables from this deposit (Chornobyl Exclusion Zone, Skolivski Beskydy, Pripyat-Polesia), each an independent array and population. Lynx ids as deposited; their B/R/L prefixes are not defined in the deposit and each id is treated as one individual, as the authors did. 49 of 50 deposited stations operated.
